cards.title: Public site and interactive product showcase
cards.desc: Landing, product, methodology, pricing, security, contact, resources, docs, and policy pages; interactive scan-state demo; public benchmark page.
acceptance: Public pages are production-presentable with self-hosted visuals
Product showcase runs the full queued → analyzing → complete cycle
Benchmark page renders the V0.1 findings as a designed experience

cards.title: Minimal Supabase auth and invite onboarding
cards.desc: Sign in / sign out, password reset (request + confirm), invite-based onboarding with accept flow, protected routes, and admin gating.
acceptance: Sign in, sign out, and reset flows work end-to-end
Invite tokens are consumed on acceptance
Protected and admin routes enforce the right access

cards.title: User workspace — 15/15 pages shipped
cards.desc: Dashboard, Uploads, Queue, History, Reports (+ detail + print), Account, Notifications, Activity, Organization, Billing, API Keys, Docs/Help, Security, Team — on the ui primitives.
acceptance: Every page has loading/empty/error states and ?state= demo forcing
Every surface registers ⌘K commands
Team scoping is URL-backed and shareable

cards.title: Admin workspace — 12/12 pages shipped
cards.desc: Overview, Waitlist, Users, Organizations, Feature Flags, Analytics, Monitoring, Audit Logs, Jobs, Reports, Roles, Settings — mock-backed with demo forcing.
acceptance: All 12 admin pages render on the ui primitives
?state= demo forcing covers every admin data surface
Admin team scoping (?team=) is linkable

cards.title: Global error boundary with crash recovery
cards.desc: Approved 2026-08-04. Recoverable fallback around the app shell so no crashing page blanks the screen; dev-only stack trace; telemetry stub.
acceptance: A thrown error shows retry/reload instead of a blank page
onError feeds the local telemetry buffer
Prod builds hide stack details

cards.title: Client-side report PDF export
cards.desc: Approved 2026-08-04, shipped 2026-08-07. Print-to-PDF from the printable report view with a print stylesheet and export buttons on detail + print pages and ⌘K.
acceptance: Export PDF button on report detail, print page, and command palette
Print stylesheet keeps panels intact across page breaks
Pre/post export toasts and a descriptive save filename

cards.title: Admin analytics and monitoring (pages + real endpoint)
cards.desc: Analytics + Monitoring pages and the real GET /admin/analytics aggregation; queue health, storage, DB, and external-service panels.
acceptance: GET /admin/analytics aggregates volume, rates, media types, top orgs
Monitoring surfaces queue health and service status
TrendChart and StackedBarChart primitives reused across admin

cards.title: Admin backend endpoints: jobs, reports, roles, settings, audit-logs
cards.desc: Derivation-based admin endpoints behind AdminGuard matching the mock shapes the pages consume, plus job retry/fail actions.
acceptance: GET /admin/jobs, /reports, /roles, /settings, /audit-logs match page contracts
POST /admin/jobs/:id/retry and /fail honor the guard semantics
Audit logs reuse the actor-scoped pattern with severity map and CSV export

cards.title: Scan upload and queue round-trip backend
cards.desc: POST /v1/scans creates a row and returns a signed Supabase Storage URL; submit enqueues a BullMQ job; worker marks analyzing → completed and writes the result payload; frontend polling observes transitions.
acceptance: Signed-URL upload round-trip persists media to Storage
Worker transitions queued → analyzing → completed
GET /scans/:id returns the real report payload
e2e spec covers initiate → upload → submit → process → report with a mocked Supabase client

cards.title: Account activity endpoint
cards.desc: GET /v1/account/activity reads auth_audit_events scoped to the user with category filters and pagination matching the Activity page's contract.
acceptance: Events are scoped to the requesting user only
Category filters and page/pageSize/total match the mock shape
Missing email returns 400; pagination clamps safely

cards.title: Organization management (page + real API paths)
cards.desc: Member roster with roles and team access, invite flow with pending invites, workspace profile; api.js real-path branches behind USE_MOCK gating.
acceptance: api.js real-path branches for GET /organization, invites, member role/team PATCH, and DELETE are wired behind USE_MOCK gating
Owner/admin gating matches the permission model
USE_MOCK keeps the demo flow intact while the live backend module lands separately

cards.title: Formatter consolidation and completion sign-off
cards.desc: All date/number/duration/storage formatters consolidated in scanPresentation.js with locale pinned to en-US and a vitest edge-case suite; ?state= forcing on every data page.
acceptance: No hand-rolled formatting remains outside the shared module
63-test vitest suite covers null/NaN/zero/rounding edges
Sign-off checklist records ?state= on 22/22 data pages

cards.title: URL-backed team scoping and copy-link
cards.desc: useTeamScoping + generic useQueryParam power ?team= / ?from= / ?to= filters that survive navigation; Copy link affordance; back/forward no longer fights the URL.
acceptance: Team filter persists in the URL and restores on mount
Date ranges compose with team scoping in one shareable link
Copy link strips dev-only demo params
External URL edits settle without ping-pong

cards.title: Trello sync CLI
cards.desc: Zero-dependency scripts/trello.mjs: init, push, move, comment, snapshot, status — idempotent upserts by card title with phase/type/priority labels and acceptance criteria.
acceptance: init, push, move, comment, snapshot, status commands work
Push upserts idempotently and validates the spec before network calls
Pure helpers covered by the vitest spec

cards.title: CI gates and render smoke coverage
cards.desc: GitHub Actions runs npm test + lint + build on push/PR; smoke.sh boots the built app and curls key routes; render smokes catch mount-order regressions.
acceptance: CI fails on test, lint, or build regressions
Smoke step fails on blank-page regressions
Render smokes cover the team-scoped pages

cards.title: Scan deduplication (hash-based)
cards.desc: Approved 2026-08-04. Hash the uploaded media (sha256 fingerprint) and reuse an identical file's completed result instead of reprocessing.
acceptance: Upload computes a content hash before enqueue
An identical prior scan surfaces its completed report
Fingerprint is exposed in the report metadata

cards.title: Organization backend module
cards.desc: Supabase migration defining organizations/teams/members/invites tables plus the NestJS organization module matching the api.js real-path branches.
acceptance: Migration adds orgs, teams, members, and invites tables
GET /organization, invites, member role/team PATCH, and DELETE work
Owner/admin 403s, strict team 400s, and seat/duplicate rules enforced
Seed script creates the owner member, teams, and sample scans

cards.title: Notifications backend
cards.desc: GET /v1/notifications reads a notifications table scoped to the user, mapping to the mockNotifications shape with read-state and mark-read support for the bell and notifications page.
acceptance: Notifications are scoped to the requesting user
Bell badge and page reflect read/unread state
Mark-read persists and the unread count updates

cards.title: Active sessions surface
cards.desc: Persist session records on sign-in/refresh; expose GET/DELETE /v1/security/sessions to the Security page; revoke server-side via Supabase admin signOut.
acceptance: Session rows are recorded on sign-in and refresh
Security page lists and revokes real sessions
Revoking signs the session out server-side

cards.title: Live end-to-end validation with USE_MOCK off
cards.desc: Flip USE_MOCK off against a local Supabase + backend and walk the full user flow — sign in, upload, queue, report — to catch contract mismatches before deployment.
acceptance: Sign in works against the real auth path
Upload → queue → processing → report completes end-to-end
Any frontend/backend contract mismatches are fixed and recorded

cards.title: Session hardening — httpOnly cookies and rotation
cards.desc: Approved 2026-08-04, required before broader beta. Move the Supabase session flow to httpOnly cookie storage with rotation and refresh handling on the backend; document the migration path from the localStorage token flow.
acceptance: Sessions ride httpOnly cookies, not localStorage tokens
Refresh rotation invalidates the previous session
Logout revokes the session server-side
Migration path for the current localStorage flow is documented

cards.title: Sentry + PostHog observability baseline
cards.desc: Approved 2026-08-04, before first real users. Sentry for errors (frontend + API + worker) and PostHog for activation funnels.
acceptance: Sentry captures frontend, API, and worker errors
PostHog tracks the waitlist → sign-in → first-scan funnel
Local telemetry stub routes into Sentry on activation

cards.title: Usage and entitlement enforcement
cards.desc: Approved for later release. Enforce per-plan scan quotas on initiateScan (402 + Retry-After when exhausted) and surface metering in the Billing page.
acceptance: initiateScan returns 402 with Retry-After at quota
Billing page metering reflects real usage
Plan limits are configuration-driven

cards.title: Evidence appendix in reports
cards.desc: Approved for later release. Methodology + limitations appendix for court-oriented trust, included in the printable report.
acceptance: Appendix renders methodology and limitations sections
Included in the PDF export flow
Language avoids overstating confidence

cards.title: Real image signal pipeline in the worker
cards.desc: Move image evidence extraction into the worker: EXIF metadata via exifr with validation, perceptual hashing and signal computation, sharp thumbnails — the 5-signal structure behind the reports.
acceptance: Worker extracts metadata, hashes, and signals without blocking the API
Perceptual hash feeds dedup and fingerprinting
Thumbnails render via sharp at scale

cards.title: Queue reliability hardening
cards.desc: Retries, stalled-job recovery, failure states, and status tracking via BullMQ; reduce queue infrastructure waste and document the Redis strategy.
acceptance: Failed and stalled jobs recover with clear retry semantics
Status transitions are measurable and cost-aware
Redis strategy (Upstash/Valkey) is documented

cards.title: Result payload versioning and report depth
cards.desc: Version the result payload structure where needed and deepen report evidence blocks without overstating confidence.
acceptance: Payload schema carries an explicit version
Older payloads still render in the report surface
Evidence blocks stay honest about confidence

cards.title: Benchmark methodology
cards.desc: Establish methodology for speed, accuracy, and pipeline validation; grow the Provance-1000 catalog coverage.
acceptance: Benchmark runs are reproducible and documented
Speed and accuracy metrics feed the public benchmark page
Catalog coverage is tracked

cards.title: Security hardening — RLS, rate limits, file validation
cards.desc: Broader authorization and RLS hardening, rate limiting and bot protection, file-validation posture, and admin protections review.
acceptance: RLS covers scans, members, and org data
Rate limits protect public and authenticated routes
Upload validation rejects malformed and oversize files

cards.title: MVP launch readiness and Founder review package
cards.desc: Full product readiness review from waitlist to report completion; close remaining P0/P1 bugs; validate build/test/deploy gates; confirm docs match shipped behavior; prepare the Founder review package.
acceptance: Release gates pass (test, lint, build, backend, e2e)
Onboarding through report completion is validated end-to-end
Documentation reflects shipped behavior
Founder approval is granted for the MVP release

cards.title: Multimodal verification — video and audio
cards.desc: Deferred. Video via FFmpeg-based workers with frame extraction on separate queues (never in-API); audio with waveform/metadata evidence blocks as a controlled beta expansion.
acceptance: Video jobs run on isolated queues with async notifications
Frame-level evidence blocks render in reports
Audio evidence blocks appear in a controlled beta

cards.title: Webhooks UI
cards.desc: Approved for later release (roadmap: Post-MVP Expansion Themes). Create and manage webhook endpoints alongside API keys, with scopes and test delivery.
acceptance: Webhook create/update/delete UI beside API keys
Scope selection mirrors the API key scopes
Test-delivery sends a sample event
